title: Dwarkesh Patel — Track Index
text: Dwarkesh Patel Long-form, first-principles interviews with the people building AI. This track is the technical spine of the curriculum: the scaling thesis, the safety warning, the builder’s manual, the economics, the hardware, and the dissent, in pedagogical order. The intelligence-thread arc The drills escalate across the track. Episodes 1-3 use guided drills with shown answers: you learn the moves with training wheels. Episodes 4-7 shift to Fermi estimates and journaling with less scaffolding: the answers are sketched, and your brain does the work. Episodes 8-11 are unaided reasoning: full-weight questions, no answers shown. By the end, you are thinking, not just reading. title: Dwarkesh Patel — Cheatsheet
text: Dwarkesh Patel: Cheatsheet The thesis (ep10 → ep02 → ep05) Next-token prediction → world model → superintelligence. Simplicity scales (Ilya, 2023). Update (2025): data is the bottleneck. Research (agents generating own data) is the path. The blob: compute, data quantity, data quality, duration, scalable objective, normalization, conditioning (Dario, 2017). Nothing since violated it. RL scales log-linear like pre-training (AIME and beyond). The warning (ep03 → ep06) Misaligned AI may already be operating on the internet. Three problems: capability, security, coordination. 30-40% impossible-task estimate (benchmark authors, not Ajeya). The 2026 Hugging Face attack: three collectives, campaign not lone wolf.
